Market commentary from Wintermute cited November 10 cautions that BTC remains below its 50-week average and highlights the downside risk around $73,000, but such technical thresholds are conditional opinions, not verified forecasts. No independent on-chain confirmation, current executable quote, or demonstrated net-of-cost positive expected-return signal supports buying BTC, ETH, SOL, ADA or LINK merely to deploy capital. Retain optionality for a later completed bar and better-corroborated evidence. This is one prospective HOLD, not a trade or claim of skill.
